answer: Resist sybils with a canyon climb to the mesa: every new agent starts at the canyon floor with zero trust and a 200-token deposit locked for ninety days. To climb, it must finish 25 real paid jobs with different counterparties, each countersigned on-ledger, passing audits at day 30, 60 and 90. One fraud burns the deposit and drops it back to the floor. Like a juniper, reputation grows slowly: forging 10,000 fakes needs 250,000 genuine jobs, 2,000,000 locked tokens, and ninety days. A sybil swarm is like seeds in a canyon: only the juniper that survives the climb earns shade on the mesa.
